title: Leab-Tui 3D — Traditional Xiangqi Trick-Taking Studio
description: A bilingual, interactive 3D studio for เลี๊ยบตุ่ย (Leab-Tui), the Thai trick-taking game played with the 32 tiles of a Chinese chess set. Vanilla HTML5, CSS3 and ES2022 JavaScript with Three.js r160 and serverless PeerJS/WebRTC multiplayer from pinned CDNs.

releaseHistory.summary: Initial release: rules engine, four-seat 3D table, AI, bilingual coach, inspector, undo, audio, persistence and documentation.
Display settings: four interface text sizes and three themes (Mahogany, Jade Court, Midnight Lacquer) with matching UI and 3D table palettes.
Removed the distracting floating turn chevron; the active seat ring and TURN chip carry turn state.
Added Parchment and Daybreak bright themes with full CSS and 3D palettes; five-theme picker.
Added a bilingual pictorial rank-order quick reference with red/black Hanzi, names, rank numbers and tie rules.
Enlarged the rank-order sheet to near-full stage width with larger tiles, names and a two-column mobile layout.
Fixed the rank-sheet Hanzi size (44 px/36 px) and stacked the red/black medallions for table comparison.
Serverless host-authoritative WebRTC multiplayer: lobby, room codes, 2–4 humans, bot fill, per-seat redaction, seat-relative view, disconnect-to-bot and two-browser verification.

Launch prompt on every normal load with Resume match; required player names for host and guest; invite links ask the guest to confirm their name; dedicated Leave room with confirmation; host Start hidden after kickoff; compact mobile room chip; 13-check two-browser suite.
Host-routed text chat, full-mesh P2P voice, independent mic mute/deafen, remote audio elements, speaking pulse, chat/voice screenshots and 17-check two-browser suite.
Host approval queue, strong generated PIN with memory-only SHA-256 digest, Copy room info, abuse caps, voice allowlist, security docs and 21-check two-browser suite.
Copy invite + PIN, native Share, guest Paste with passcode extraction, 38 self-tests.
Version chip/reload, versioned assets, no-store update banner, diagnostics/probe, join retry diagnostics and mobile join intent restore.
Five-digit PIN, clearer Leave room button, 5-digit paste extraction and security documentation updated.
iPad landscape keyboard-safe join modal and high-contrast approval controls.
Prevent accidental backdrop dismissal of the Host/Join launch prompt.
Simplified Host a table: removed redundant Copy invite link and code-help label.
Friendlier launch menu, host/join panels, obvious Join audio, in-dialog EN/TH switch, theme-aware chat colours.
Automatic audio join on start/connect, with a persisted opt-out checkbox.
Unprefixed room numbers, big Reload version bar, throttled self-update.
Top-view default with a 3D toggle, and free hand arrangement by dragging.
Manual showdown choices, result banner with host duration, last-trick panel, segmented view switch, detailed pile cards.
Dancing 3D summary, host-gated next round with 5s auto-start, showdown button and HUD pointer fixes.
Allow showing a losing legal set at showdown.
Captured pile cards show the source player.
Trick history browser, host auto-next toggle, boot version guard.
Drag a tile onto the table to play it.
Table zones, double-click show, Turn/Now wording.
Deeper personal arrangement zone.
Capture visibility/grouping fixes, winner check, leave in top bar, Cancel turn.
Reveal result panel with a big Continue before the sweep.
Staged drag-to-play and the arrangement design record.
Chuan clarified as standard; in-app rules text updated.
Illustrated rules document with worked examples.
Chuan-aware result explanations and pile popup details.
Turn-Log-style reveal result panel.
Large winner badge on captured pile cards.
Experimental draft deal with host toggle and P2P relay.
Shared comparison popup for reveal results and turn history.
Table draft switch, logged bot picks and a large host PIN.
Random bot draft picks.
Seed reaches the draft; redraw deals a different hand.
Full-circle trick result for everyone; guest auto-rejoin.
Tablet reset-board shortcut and WebGL recovery.
2D pan/zoom with fixed orientation; launch-menu Draft toggle.
Update preserves the table: solo resume and guest reconnecting view.
Installable full-screen web app with icons and safe-area layout.
Late join, bot replacement, viewers and 30-minute join pause.
Show legal losing sets; explain illegal submissions.
Shadow-free 2D and iPad portrait/landscape table fitting with emulated checks.
iPad hint placement, inspector selection fallback and H hand controls.
Restore the C/M/A/i/H/L panel rail on iPad landscape.
Turn-log sheet exposes the shared play-history browser on iPad.
Invite from solo, audience queue, watchers, keepalive, resync and iPad hand fixes.

multiplayer.disconnect: seat becomes a bot, hand/score preserved
limits: same-tab host reload recovery; no cross-tab or cross-device host migration
late join requires host approval; viewers have no seat/chat/voice
